name: fast-clef-compaction
description: Verbatim Clef-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, via Cloudflare Workers AI.

apiKey.title: Cloudflare API token
apiKey.description: Workers AI API token. Leave unset to use CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Clef probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Clef state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Clef request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Clef request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Clef request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Clef decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
